blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Elgin Chantrell, September 2026. Detached houses: 74 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 13 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 30 sold over 4 months against an average of 78.8 listed, about 10.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 10.8 listed, about 5.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 4 sold.
